object.name: EncryptedPassportElement
object.description: Describes documents or other Telegram Passport elements shared with the bot by the user.
object.html_description: Describes documents or other Telegram Passport elements shared with the bot by the user.
object.rst_description: Describes documents or other Telegram Passport elements shared with the bot by the user.

annotations.name: data
annotations.description: Optional. Base64-encoded encrypted Telegram Passport element data provided by the user; available only for 'personal_details', 'passport', 'driver_license', 'identity_card', 'internal_passport' and 'address' types. Can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.
annotations.html_description: Optional. Base64-encoded encrypted Telegram Passport element data provided by the user; available only for “personal_details”, “passport”, “driver_license”, “identity_card”, “internal_passport” and “address” types. Can be decrypted and verified using the accompanying EncryptedCredentials.
annotations.rst_description: *Optional*.
